ingredients.name: butter or margarine, or use cooking spray (optional)

steps.instruction: Beat 5 eggs with 1 teaspoon of sugar, 1/4 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of pepper.
Heat two frying pans over medium heat.
Grease the pans with 1 to 2 tablespoons of butter or margarine.
steps.spoken: Grease each pan with 1 to 2 tablespoons of butter or margarine in all, or use cooking spray.

steps.instruction: Add 1 cubed potato to one pan.
Cook the potato until light brown.
Add 1 minced small onion to the potato.
Pour half of the egg mixture into the other pan.
Cook the egg for about 1 minute, until it starts to set.
Add the onion, the potato and 1/2 cup of shredded cheese on top of the egg.
Fold the plain side over the filling and cook 30 seconds more.
